clips.title: The story
paras: Dustwind harpies threaten travelers on Razorwind Canyon’s road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. The rocky gulch cuts through Durotar, and the harpies make the route north toward the Horde capital dangerous.

Razorwind Canyon runs beside the main road from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Its gullies reach into the eastern bluffs and west toward Tor'kren Farm. Dustwind harpies nest among the rocks and attack travelers who stray too close to their roosts. With the canyon so near the capital’s trade route, Durotar’s defenders must keep watch over its gullies.

Razorwind Canyon’s winding passages cut through Durotar’s red rock hills. An eastern branch runs deep into the crags, through a cavern, and into Drygulch Ravine. Harpies roost on high perches and descend in flocks, so travelers crossing the passes can be surrounded and cut down.
